summary: Open-source AI low-code platform for Java business systems, with code generation, AI apps, knowledge bases and Claude Code skills.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: JeecgBoot is a free, open-source AI low-code platform for building business systems in Java. It generates full-stack code, forms, workflows, reports and dashboards, and includes an AI application platform with chat assistants, knowledge bases and workflow orchestration.
sixtySeconds.problem: Enterprise Java apps repeat the same work: permissions, CRUD screens, workflows and reports. JeecgBoot builds those in and lets AI generate only the business-specific parts, which the README says removes about 80% of repetitive work.
whoFor: Java teams building internal business systems
Companies needing workflows, reports and permissions
Developers using Claude Code to generate apps
Teams adding AI chat and knowledge bases to products
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a mature, Apache-2.0 platform that is free for commercial use and combines low-code tools with AI generation and an AI app platform.
requirements: Maven and pnpm for the one-click script

overview: The platform covers permissions, multi-tenancy, data permissions, workflow (BPM), reports, dashboards, an AI knowledge base and AI chat with RAG. AI Skills, paired with Claude Code, generate CRUD code, online forms, reports, BPMN flows and dashboards from one sentence.
The frontend uses Ant Design Vue, Vue 3, TypeScript and Vite; the backend uses Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Alibaba and MyBatis-Plus. It supports models such as ChatGPT, DeepSeek and Ollama.

The quickest start is the Docker Compose script; the frontend opens at http://localhost and the backend API at http://localhost:8080/jeecg-boot. The default account is admin with password 123456. Licence: Apache-2.0.
strengths: AI plus low-code in one platform
limitations: Main README is in Chinese (English version available)
